Several users also think 42.20.4 broke it, and the 'auto mechanic' option not appearing is the usual symptom. On a server with the Lua checksum on, the mod must be installed server-side too, not only by the client.

ReloadAllMagazines.text:
-AI-
It rewrites ISInventoryPaneContextMenu.doMagazineMenu, so it is incompatible with anything else that touches that function - which is why it must sit at the BOTTOM of the load order to survive next to gun mods. Several users report it simply not working on 42.20.3 and 42.20.4; others say 42.20 singleplayer is fine. If magazines stop loading, its position in the order is the first thing to check.

cleanashes.text:
-AI-
Multiplayer bug confirmed by the author on 42.18: the collected ashes and charcoal get stuck in your inventory and cannot be dropped, put in a container, or placed - reconnecting clears the ghost items. It was also reported broken on 42.20.2 and working again on 42.20.3, so keep it updated. Singleplayer has been fine throughout.

twistmapimprovements.text:
-AI-
Needs game 42.19 or newer. Its mod.info declares the Map Symbol Size Slider family incompatible. Reports are split on 42.20: the author says he tested every feature and it all works, while users report resizing doing nothing and text not appearing - his answer is to disable other map mods and test this one alone. Its icon module is installed and untagged.

AutoSmashAndClimb.text:
-AI-
The author built it for Build 42 SINGLE PLAYER only and says his mods are not designed for multiplayer; a user confirms it does not work on a 42.13.1 dedicated server. Its MP module is installed but untagged. Reported symptom when something conflicts: each button press does only one step (smash, then clear, then climb) instead of the whole chain.

LAWLYPOPS_TPMSINDICATOR.text:
-AI-
Small annoyance worth knowing: the gauge only reads its sandbox thresholds once at game start, so changing them mid-session does nothing until you reload. It also draws on top of Realistic Dashboard & Gauges if you ever add that. Author fixed it for 42.19; 42.20 is not confirmed on the page.

SmarterStorageExtraPresets.text:
-AI-
Needs Smarter Storage, which is installed - keep the base mod above it in the order.

P4TidyUpMeister.text:
-AI-
The busiest conflict in this list. Users report: it stops you riding the Bicycle! mod (both installed - disabling Tidy Up Meister lets the bike work); Better Auto Mechanics needs Tidy Up Meister switched OFF to work (also installed); and it is incompatible with Inventory Tetris. On a 42.20 MP server, right-clicking a weapon on the ground, in a container or on a corpse to put it on your belt or back is undone by this mod, which sends the weapon back where it came from. V2 was completely redesigned for 42.20 to watch the Timed Action queue instead of patching each action, which is why it now touches so much. Re-equipping can be turned off from the character context menu - that is the quickest test when something odd happens.

SwapIt.text:
-AI-
On B42 the two dependencies are genuinely REQUIRED, not optional as on B41: errorMagnifier and Mod Update and Alert System - both are installed, and both have notes of their own. The author says load order should not matter. Open bug threads for 42.20: an error and no action when pressing a number key to equip, and a report of the character freezing in place.

PeekAView.text:
-AI-
Needs ZombieBuddy, so it inherits ZombieBuddy's setup problem - see that note. Declared incompatible with ClearCanopy. Useful multiplayer fix from a user: if it works in singleplayer but not on a server, the server-side workshop folder 3710281407\mods is often empty; delete that folder and restart the server so PZ downloads it again. Client-side only, safe to add or remove mid-save, last tested by the author against 42.20.4.

JeevesPatches_DAMN.text:
-AI-
Rule for this whole item: enable EITHER the all-in-one patch OR the individual patches, never both. You have the individual route (DAMN and Tanker), which is correct. The author now says the DAMN patch is mostly redundant because damnlib fixed most of what it patched - what remains is a recipe category fix and breaking vanilla tires down into KI5 materials.

JeevesPatches_Tanker.text:
-AI-
Removal warning from the author: this patch installs a 300L tank as a REAL vehicle part on the M49A2C, so removing the patch takes that part off the truck and any fuel inside it with it. Take the fuel out first. Everything else in Jeeve's Patches is safe to add and remove mid-save.

ZModUnbork.text:
-AI-
Needs zdk, which has its own open 42.20.4 problems. Users report it as outdated and broken on recent builds, and that its fixes are not replicated to other players on a server - characters revived by it look normal in singleplayer and wrong in multiplayer. If it stutters, turn off 'log stats' in its mod options. Only useful while you actually run one of the old mods it revives.

NicksSledgehammerFix.text:
-AI-
It replaces ISDestroyStuffAction:complete(), so it will fight any other mod that replaces the same function. Safe to add and remove otherwise, SP and MP.

MoodleFramework_SafetyPatch.text:
-AI-
This is the multiplayer patch for Moodle Framework, and it is installed but wears NO tag, so it is in no config and never loads. Moodle Framework is enabled and has open multiplayer problems (see its note) - if you play multiplayer, tag this and put it IMMEDIATELY after Moodle Framework, with every other moodle mod after it. In singleplayer it is not needed. The author tested it only on 42.13.x.

Erikas_Tiles.text:
-AI-
Broken, and correctly untagged. Game 42.20 introduced a limit of 512 textures per texture sheet, which this pack exceeds - users report it breaking map loads and the debug item spawner. Tikitown dropped it as a dependency for that reason. Nothing installed here requires it, so leave it off.

KillCount.text:
-AI-
Untagged, so it is not loading - which is just as well. Users report it does not work on 42.20.3 multiplayer, crashes when killing zombies with pipe bombs, and crashes in combination with the Bandits mod, which you do run. Open bug threads for an isLocalPlayer runtime error on every zombie death in 42.20.2.

UnifiedCarryWeightFramework.text:
-AI-
Untagged, so not loading. If you ever enable it: on 42.20.2 multiplayer it fails the Lua checksum with 'File doesn't exist on the client: media/lua/shared/unifiedcarryweightframework.lua' because the mod still ships a 42.19 folder - the only known workaround is DoLuaChecksum=false.

w_betterwringing.text:
-AI-
In multiplayer the 'wring out all' action stops after the first item, confirmed by several users; singleplayer is fine. A user suspects it fights mods with re-equip logic such as Tidy Up Meister, which is installed here. Safe to add or remove mid-save.

BBB.text:
-AI-
Better Backpack Bottoms - containers in the bag bottom (toolbox, first aid kit, lunchbox, tacklebox, gas/jerry can, bottles).

Load order matters here: Better Backpack Bottoms FIRST, then Bag Bottom Weapon Attach.
Both mods rewrite the attachments offered by the same three bag-bottom slots (BedrollBottom, BedrollBottomBig, BedrollBottomALICE). Wherever they both reach the same backpack, whichever loads LAST supplies that slot's list - so with BBB first, the weapon categories are the ones that land.

BagBottomWeaponAttach.text:
-AI-
Bag Bottom Weapon Attach - rifles and large back-slot weapons in the bag bottom.

Load order matters here: Better Backpack Bottoms FIRST, then Bag Bottom Weapon Attach.
Both mods rewrite the attachments offered by the same three bag-bottom slots (BedrollBottom, BedrollBottomBig, BedrollBottomALICE). Wherever they both reach the same backpack, whichever loads LAST supplies that slot's list - so with BBB first, the weapon categories are the ones that land.
